productName: French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table
description:
Combine abundant storage with daily convenience in the French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table from Old Time Oak. Six spacious drawers provide room for everything your baby needs, while the attached changing table creates a dedicated, comfortable diaper station.
The changing table features safety rails and a comfortable changing height, making diaper changes easier on your back. Below, six dovetailed drawers with smooth-gliding hardware offer organized storage for clothing, blankets, diapers, and wipes. The solid wood construction and French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, make this a piece you will be proud to have in your nursery.
When your little one outgrows the diaper stage, the changing table can be removed, leaving a beautiful six-drawer dresser that serves your child through the teenage years. Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout. Coordinates with the complete French Country collection.
